annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: Shared tiling-family transport: the engine-managed screen set, window lifecycle notifications from the KWin effect, and geometry/focus/float requests to it. Engine-specific control lives on org.plasmazones.Autotile and org.plasmazones.Scrolling.

annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: Whether any tiling-family engine is active on any screen (read-only, derived from assignments).

annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: UNION of every tiling-family engine's screens. org.plasmazones.Scrolling names the scrolling subset.

annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: Per-screen RULES-VISIBLE active layout id (screenId to string): a snapping layout UUID, autotile:<algorithmId>, scrolling:<templateUuid> for a templated scrolling context, or the bare scrolling: sentinel when no template resolves. Pushed by the daemon so effect-evaluated window rules see the same ActiveLayout vocabulary as daemon-evaluated context rules. Covers EVERY effective screen, not just engine-managed ones.

annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: Force retiling of windows on a screen, or all screens if empty.

annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: Screen to retile, or empty for all screens.

annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: Force retiling of all engine-managed screens. Convenience method equivalent to retile with an empty screen ID.

annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: Notify the daemon that a window has been focused (called from KWin effect). Updates the owning engine's focus tracking and window-to-screen mapping.

annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: Window ID that gained focus.

annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: Screen where the window is located (for window-to-screen mapping update).

annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: Notify the daemon that a window was opened (called from KWin effect).

annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: Window ID from KWin.

annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: Screen where the window appeared.

annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: Window minimum width in pixels (0 if unconstrained).

annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: Window minimum height in pixels (0 if unconstrained).

annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: Batch window-opened notifications: process multiple windowOpened in one D-Bus call. Used on daemon startup/restart and mode toggle-on. Array of (windowId, screenId, minWidth, minHeight).

annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: Array of window-opened entry structs.

annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: Update a window's minimum size at runtime. Called by KWin effect when a window's minimum size changes after initial windowOpened. Triggers retiling if the value differs.

annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: Window ID from KWin.

annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: New minimum width in pixels (0 if unconstrained).

annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: New minimum height in pixels (0 if unconstrained).

annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: Notify the daemon that a window was closed (called from KWin effect).

annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: Window ID from KWin.

annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: Emitted when the pipeline enabled state changes (any engine active/inactive).

annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: New enabled state.

annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: Emitted when the set of engine-managed screens changes. Also RE-EMITTED with an unchanged set on a desktop/activity switch between contexts with identical NON-EMPTY managed sets (isDesktopSwitch=true) so the effect's catch-scan can re-add windows moved here while the user was away — an empty identical set skips the re-emit, and receivers must be idempotent for the same-set case.

annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: List of screen IDs currently engine-managed.

annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: True if the change is due to desktop/activity switch (effect should skip geometry restore/re-notification).

annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: Emitted when any screen's rules-visible active layout changes (see the activeLayouts property for the value vocabulary). Deduplicated: the daemon pushes on every screen-set recompute and only actual map changes reach the wire.

annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: Full screenId to rules-visible layout id map after the change.

annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: Emitted when tiling layout changes for a screen.

annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: Screen that was retiled.

annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: Emitted when windows should be moved to new geometries (batch).

annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: Array of (windowId, x, y, width, height, zoneId, screenId, monocle, floating, stacking).

annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: Emitted when a window should be focused by the KWin effect.

annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: Window ID to focus.

annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: Emitted when windows are released from engine management (e.g., screen left an engine-managed mode). KWin effect should restore these windows to pre-tile geometry.

annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: Window IDs no longer under engine control.

annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: Emitted when a window's floating state changes.

annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: Window ID whose floating state changed.

annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: Whether the window is now floating.

annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: Screen where the window is located.
